field.label: Test program
field.help: Save installs the chosen program and removes the other one. speedtest-cli comes from the OPNsense package repository. The Ookla binary is downloaded from install.speedtest.net and checked against a SHA-256 pinned in this plugin; it is usually more accurate on fast links.

field.label: Accept Ookla terms
field.help: Required for the Ookla binary. I accept the Ookla end user license agreement and privacy policy, including that test results are shared with Ookla.

field.label: Server id
field.help: Server used by scheduled tests and by "Run speedtest" when no other server is picked. Leave empty to let the program pick the nearest server.

field.label: Interface
field.help: Run the test from this interface, for multi-WAN setups. Leave on "Default route" to follow the routing table. The Ookla binary binds to the device, speedtest-cli to the interface's first IPv4 address.

field.label: Keep history (days)
field.help: Results older than this are removed after each test. 0 keeps everything.

field.label: Run on a schedule
field.help: Adds a system cron job; no entry under System: Settings: Cron is needed.

field.label: Interval
field.help: Every N hours counts from midnight, so every 6 hours runs at 00, 06, 12 and 18.

field.label: Minute
field.help: Minute past the hour. Pick something other than :00 so tests do not collide with other hourly jobs.
